잠언 29:1.content: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

잠언 29:2.content: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

잠언 29:3.content: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.

잠언 29:4.content: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.

잠언 29:5.content: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.

잠언 29:6.content: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

잠언 29:7.content: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.

잠언 29:8.content: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.

잠언 29:9.content: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

잠언 29:10.content: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.

잠언 29:11.content: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

잠언 29:12.content: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.

잠언 29:13.content: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the Lord lighteneth both their eyes.

잠언 29:14.content: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

잠언 29:15.content: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.

잠언 29:16.content: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.

잠언 29:17.content: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.

잠언 29:18.content: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

잠언 29:19.content: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.

잠언 29:20.content: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

잠언 29:21.content: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.

잠언 29:22.content: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

잠언 29:23.content: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.

잠언 29:24.content: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

잠언 29:25.content: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.

잠언 29:26.content: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment cometh from the Lord.

잠언 29:27.content: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
